claims.nodeLabel: CEFAA / SEFAA - Chilean anomalous aerial phenomena office, Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil
claims.text: As of October 2018 CEFAA comprised 'su Director, Hugo Camus Palacios y dos investigadores', supported by an external research committee of astronomers, geographers, physicists, psychologists, a nuclear chemist, aerospace medicine professionals, air traffic controllers, a meteorologist, aeronautical investigators, inspector pilots, aeronautical engineers, image analysts and armed forces representatives.
